title: Stricter validation against a caller that sends a new field
class: Validation added against a caller that now sends rejected input
story: A hardens POST /api/cart: a body may only hold id and qty, so a client can't send its own price. B lets a shopper say a substitute is fine for a line, sent as a new substitute field on the same request. Together, every request B's client sends is refused with 400.

a.why: refuse fields a basket line doesn't have

fact.sentence: The basket refuses fields it doesn't know, so a client can't set its own price

b.why: let a shopper accept a substitute

fact.sentence: A shopper can say a substitute is fine for a basket line

resolution: The allowed fields are id, qty and substitute.
